traits.name: Brute
traits.text:
A melee weapon attack deals one extra die of its damage when
the obsidian elemental hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.text:
When the obsidian elemental dies, it explodes, and each
creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw,
taking 10 (3d6) slashing damage and 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed
saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Molten Glass
traits.text:
A creature that hits the obsidian elemental with a melee
attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The obsidian elemental makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10
(2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
